title: Rational Decision Making Explained | Principles of Management Ep 23
description:
All five Chai Corner outlets need fresh milk, and three dairies want the deal. Kabir wants the cheapest, Asha wants the best milk, and Meena wants the closest. Instead of guessing, Ravi uses the rational decision-making model and a weighted scoring table to pick the supplier that gives the most value.

You will learn what rational decision making means (using pure logic to choose the option with the most value), what optimising is, the 6 steps of the rational model: define the problem, identify the decision criteria, weight the criteria, generate alternatives, rate each alternative, and compute and choose. We also look at its four big assumptions (a clear problem, every option known, fixed preferences, and no limits on time or money) and why they are rarely true in real life.

This is Episode 23 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.

In this video:
0:00 Three dairies, three opinions
0:23 What is rational decision making?
0:46 The 6 steps of the rational model
1:15 Rating, weighting and the final score
1:44 Four big assumptions
2:07 Quick check
2:21 Recap
